metadata.title: Hipparcos Main Catalog
metadata.provenance: ESA Hipparcos mission catalogue hosted by NASA HEASARC; not a NASA observing mission.
metadata.query: SELECT hip_number, hd_id, ra_deg, dec_deg, vmag, spect_type, bv_color, parallax, parallax_error, pm_ra, pm_dec, pm_ra_error, pm_dec_error, var_flag, hip_var_type, var_period, dbl_mult_annex, ccdm_n_comp FROM hipparcos ORDER BY hip_number

requests.query: SELECT hip_number, hd_id, ra_deg, dec_deg, vmag, spect_type, bv_color, parallax, parallax_error, pm_ra, pm_dec, pm_ra_error, pm_dec_error, var_flag, hip_var_type, var_period, dbl_mult_annex, ccdm_n_comp FROM hipparcos WHERE hip_number <= 40000 ORDER BY hip_number

SELECT hip_number, hd_id, ra_deg, dec_deg, vmag, spect_type, bv_color, parallax, parallax_error, pm_ra, pm_dec, pm_ra_error, pm_dec_error, var_flag, hip_var_type, var_period, dbl_mult_annex, ccdm_n_comp FROM hipparcos WHERE hip_number > 40000 AND hip_number <= 80000 ORDER BY hip_number

SELECT hip_number, hd_id, ra_deg, dec_deg, vmag, spect_type, bv_color, parallax, parallax_error, pm_ra, pm_dec, pm_ra_error, pm_dec_error, var_flag, hip_var_type, var_period, dbl_mult_annex, ccdm_n_comp FROM hipparcos WHERE hip_number > 80000 ORDER BY hip_number

metadata.coordinatePolicy: Precise source ra_deg/dec_deg where available, otherwise the same NASA table rounded ra/dec columns (original precision 0.01 s of RA time and 0.1 arcsec of declination), marked positionPrecision=rounded. All positions remain at J1991.25; missing positions remain null.
metadata.properMotionConvention: pmRaMasYr is mu_alpha*cos(delta); both components and their standard errors are in mas per Julian year.
metadata.scope: Complete 118218-row Hipparcos Main Catalog; not a catalogue of every known star.
metadata.distancePolicy: Raw trigonometric parallax and its standard error are retained, including insignificant, zero and negative measurements. No distance is inferred in this snapshot.
metadata.photometryPolicy: vmag is Johnson V; bv is the Johnson B-V colour. Not every catalogue field is populated for every star.
metadata.missingValue: null; measured zero and negative values remain numeric

fieldDescriptions.componentCount: Number of Components in the Entry
fieldDescriptions.positionPrecision: precise = NASA ra_deg/dec_deg; rounded = NASA ra/dec fallback; null = no position
